issues.description: Expected output columns for Aufgabe 06: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) requires the query to return the name and the population numbers (einwohner_m and einwohner_w) for each Gemeinde with >100000 male and >100000 female inhabitants. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql) only selects the name (SELECT name ...) and does not return einwohner_m or einwohner_w. The template (template_repository/aufgabe06.sql) is empty and does not guide the student to select the additional columns. This mismatch will confuse students about which columns to return and can cause automated checks that expect the population columns to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution to return the requested columns. For example: SELECT name, einwohner_m, einwohner_w FROM Gemeinde WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000; Optionally, update the template to include the correct SELECT clause as a hint or align the problem text if the intended output should only be the name.
